From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@fastapp.io>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quickstart demo — pick a 30-min dev walkthrough

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up to try Redwood! This is an automated welcome from our intake mailbox — I’m Tessa (SDR on the developer track) and I’ll help get your team on a short, engineer-friendly walkthrough to show latency, cost, and integration patterns.

Quick options — pick one that fits your timezone and we’ll confirm:
• 30-min dev walkthrough (live): 15:00–15:30 UTC — shows SDK + local playground
• 30-min dev walkthrough (live): 19:00–19:30 UTC — later slot for APAC overlap
• If none of these work, reply with a couple of preferred windows and your timezone and I’ll match.

Suggested agenda (30 min):
1) quick infra + auth guardrails (5 min)
2) live callout: embeddings + chat demo (10 min)
3) integration Qs + next steps (15 min)

If you want an engineer on the call, reply and we’ll include one. Otherwise this is SDR-led with a short technical demo.

Schedule link: https://app.redwood.com/s/meet?coach=tessa_morgan — pick a slot and it will auto-add to your calendar.

Attachments: product one-pager attached for quick reference.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR — Developer Experience
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FastApp-Prod-OnePager.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@fastapp.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quickstart demo — pick a 30-min dev walkthrough

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the quick note. I’m in SF (PDT) and 15:00 UTC is 08:00 local for me so that’s a bit early. The 19:00 UTC slot is 12:00 PDT which could work but I have a customer sync then.

Would a 16:00–16:30 UTC slot work? That’s 09:00 PDT for me. If possible we’d like an engineer on the call — our lead engineer (me) will be attending.

Also: we have some compliance questions about VPC/private deploys and key management — if you can loop in someone from the security team that would be great, otherwise a quick list of links is fine.

—Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Platform
FastApp
